title: Spec Workflow Iteration (Current Sprint) State
description: Persistent view of the current iteration/sprint: which OpenSpec changes are proposed/in-worktree/completed/archived, their blocker relationships, and current task progress. Stored at .rddf/state/iteration.json.

version.description: Schema version. v5: added l2_violation_count_after and l2_violation_kind per-change fields (collect-l2-violation-count-on-archive 2026-08-05). v6: added filled_at per-change field (fix-iteration-schema-filled-at 2026-08-10) - tracks when a skeleton change was filled with full specs/tasks. v7: added verification object per-change field (fix-rdd-verifier-lifecycle-dashboard 2026-08-26) - independent verification lifecycle state, separate from status.

current_phase.description: Current roadmap phase (e.g. 'v2.1'). May be 'default' or 'unknown' in compat mode.

changes.description: One entry per OpenSpec change ever observed in the current iteration. Archived changes are kept (not deleted) for history.

name.description: OpenSpec change name (directory name under openspec/changes/).

phase.description: Roadmap phase this change belongs to. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

category.description: Roadmap category within the phase. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Updated by propose/guide-ship/execute/archive hooks. 'planned' = skeleton change (only .openspec.yaml + roadmap-meta.yaml + minimal proposal.md), not yet eligible for guide-ship. 'archived_partial' = shipped in parts across multiple commits (Phase B 5-step split).

archive_path.description: Path to OpenSpec archived change directory (e.g. 'openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-09-x/'). Set when change is archived; supersedes worktree_path for post-archive references.

plan_present.description: Whether .rddf/plans/<name>.md exists at archive time. False indicates plan was never generated or was deleted.

note.description: Free-form annotation explaining a partial/exceptional archive state.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the change was first added to iteration.

worktree_path.description: Path to worktree (e.g. '.rddf/wt/<name>'). Set when status transitions to in_worktree.

plan_path.description: Path to Prometheus plan (e.g. '.rddf/plans/<name>.md'). Set when plan is generated.

tasks_done.description: Number of completed tasks in tasks.md. Updated by execute hook.

tasks_total.description: Total number of tasks. Snapshot at plan generation; not auto-updated when tasks.md is edited.

blocker.description: Name of the change that hard-blocks this one (from deps). Null if ready or no deps run yet.

parallel_group.description: Topological layer from deps. Changes in the same group can run in parallel.

conflicts.description: Change names with file-level conflicts. Empty array if no deps run yet.

last_deps_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last deps run that updated blocker/group/conflicts.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when status transitioned to archived.

archive_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the archive action that transitioned this change to archived. Set by sync_iteration_after_archive helper (fix-archive-iteration-sync 2026-08-05); preserved if already set (idempotent). Null if not yet archived.

parent_feature.description: Name of the parent feature/epic this change belongs to. Set when a change is decomposed from a larger feature (e.g. feature-stream-core -> parent_feature='feature-stream'). Null for standalone changes. Redundant with name-prefix derivation but provides explicit registration for edge cases.

manual_deps.description: Human-authored dependency overrides from roadmap-meta.yaml. Changes listed here MUST complete before this one. Synced by deps hook. Null if no deps run yet.

manual_blocks.description: Human-authored reverse dependencies from roadmap-meta.yaml. Changes listed here MUST wait for this one. Synced by deps hook. Null if no deps run yet.

l2_violation_count_after.description: Project-wide L2 violation count AFTER this change was archived. Set by collect_l2_count() (collect-l2-violation-count-on-archive 2026-08-05). Null if L2 count was not collected at archive time.

l2_violation_kind.description: Which L2 violation kind was counted. Default 'sim_include_drv' (matches #include "sim/" patterns in plugins/gpu_driver/drv/). Null if not collected.

filled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when a skeleton change (status='planned') was filled with full proposal.md/design.md/specs/tasks.md. Distinguishes the 'skeleton' (added_at only) phase from the 'filled' (ready-to-ship) phase. Null for legacy changes without tracked fill time or non-skeleton changes that were never in skeleton phase. v6 (fix-iteration-schema-filled-at 2026-08-10).

verification.description: Independent verification lifecycle for a change. Optional; missing field treated as 'unknown' for active changes, 'legacy' for archived changes. Summary fields only — retry history lives in .rddf/state/verifier/<change>.json, raw verdict in .rddf/state/.ac-verdict-<change>.json, audit log in .rddf/state/verifier/<change>.audit.jsonl. v7 (fix-rdd-verifier-lifecycle-dashboard 2026-08-26).

state.description: Verification outcome state. Active change without verification data: 'unknown'. Archived change without verification data: 'legacy' (never fabricated as passed).

verdict_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the implementation branch tip the verdict is bound to. Null if not yet verified.

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last successful verification check.

route.description: Where to send the user based on classification. archive-ready → ship, guide-ship → fix implementation_gap, guide-plan → fix proposal_drift, halted → manual review.

loop_count.description: Number of retry loops completed for this change's verification.

bypass_reason.description: Audited reason string for bypassed state. Required when state='bypassed'.

bypass_source.description: Source of bypass: 'SKIP_RDD_VERIFIER' or other operator-supplied label.

archive_ready.description: True only when verification passed or bypassed with matching verdict_sha. Required by archive_gate_check.

feature_view.description: Derived view written by skills/feature.md. Optional.
